definitions.gloss: full (parking lot); no parking spaces available
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a parking lot has no available spaces. Commonly seen on signs at parking facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満車|まんしゃ}だ。
{満車|まんしゃ}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: It was full, so I looked for another parking lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満車|まんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On holidays, the lot often fills up by the morning.

notes:
FORMS:
{満|まん} (full) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). Literally "full of cars."

USAGE:
Seen on electronic signs at parking garages and lots. The opposite is ⟦{空車|くうしゃ}→空車：15999_kuusha⟧ (spaces available). Also used for taxis: ⟦{空車|くうしゃ}→空車：15999_kuusha⟧ means available for hire, while {満車|まんしゃ} is not typically used for taxis (use {回送|かいそう} for off-duty).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {満車|まんしゃ}: full, no spaces available
- ⟦{空車|くうしゃ}→空車：15999_kuusha⟧: spaces available (parking); available for hire (taxi)
- ⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧: full seating (restaurants, theaters)
